title: Trigonometry
learner: Returning learners who recognize trigonometric vocabulary but need to recover exact values, angle units, phase interpretation, and complete reasoning.
assumedKnowledge: F03 functions, transformations, and inverse domains

include: Radians, unit circle, all six ratios, and circular quantities
Sine/cosine graphs, phase, and inverse principal values
Foundational identities, sum/double-angle calculations, and bounded complete equation solution sets
exclude: Extensive identity proof drills, product-to-sum, and half-angle sign cases
Calculus of trigonometric functions and complex phasors, developed in F08/F09

routes.quick: Use the four-objective diagnostic, read the relevant Quick recall section, then attempt that lesson's independent checkpoint. Complete the four-question mixed recall after all lesson checkpoints.
routes.full: Study the four lessons in order. Work every reasoned example, complete the guided task, predict in the investigation, use fresh practice with hints, then take an independent check.

escalation.text: MTH 215 is the full-course destination, but its planned later trigonometry modules are not assumed complete. The precise free OpenStax readings supply first-time instruction beyond this refresher's scope.

reuse.source: Adapt committed mth-215/b06 without copying divergent prose or changing its IDs. Wrap the five foundation triangle families under F04 IDs. New lessons, families, and interaction logic live in refresher-owned modules.
reuse.sharedMath: Reuse exact radicals, rational arithmetic, pi-multiple and real root-set parsing and grading. Do not change the grading or persistence schemas.
reuse.overlap: Triangle modes and conversions already exist in B06; full-circle signs, phase, identities, and complete periodic equation solutions need new authored instruction.

coverage: Right-triangle side roles and calculator mode
Unit-circle exact values and undefined ratios

assessment.lessonCheckpoints: Exactly four required questions per lesson; multi-field questions cover related subskills explicitly. Mixed recall has one required question per objective.
assessment.evidence: Opening a lesson, choosing confidence, predictions, and diagnostic success create no mastery evidence. Independent checkpoints use fresh reproducible snapshots; hints remain for guided and practice work.
assessment.recommendations: Map every diagnostic and mixed family to its lesson. Persist specific misses until a later successful independent lesson check.

sharedCapabilities.interface: Lesson.interaction adds { kind: 'refresher-trig-lab', mode: 'circle' | 'wave' | 'equations', prompt: string }.
sharedCapabilities.reason: The existing triangle investigation covers only acute geometry. Full-circle signs, phase transformations, and complete solution sets need dedicated keyboard controls, accessible plots/tables, and prediction feedback.
sharedCapabilities.integration: One union member in lib/learning/contracts.ts and one import/dispatch branch in the existing lesson reader. Keep the component and math utilities under refresher-owned paths. No app-shell, storage, or answer-schema changes.

verification: Independently compare all 16 standard-angle values against geometric identities and floating trig functions; test axes and signs exactly.

Check periodic root completeness by independent branch formulas, interval boundaries, substitutions, and intentional omitted/extra roots. Check coterminal negative angles, scaled frequencies, inverse branch ranges, and impossible target values.
Compare wave period and phase using independent time and angular calculations; verify units and circle measures.
Sweep every family variant across 60 or more seeds with deterministic snapshots, equivalents, misconceptions, invalid input, and KaTeX rendering.
Browser-test diagnostics, all lesson and mixed checkpoints, all investigations, keyboard feedback, exact resume, notes, backups, mobile layouts, and Axe.
Run applicable unit tests, lint, typecheck, and production build. Only then enable verified preview; independent human review remains pending.
